title: Outcomes ending in tire replacement or workaround
summary: This topic is loosely connected by phrases about what owners 'ended up' doing, with the clearest concrete themes being costly tire replacement and a few workarounds after usability problems.

positive.summary: The lone positive review says the buyer chose the i5 and enjoyed the ownership experience.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention expensive repeated tire replacement and needing a seatbelt extender because latching was difficult.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined excerpts span unrelated outcomes such as calling BMW Assist, being locked out, overpaying, towing to find charging, cargo-fit workarounds, and administrative or location changes, so examples are insufficient for a single clear sentiment-consistent theme.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined and too short or context-poor to support a stronger topic-level conclusion.
The cluster mixes unrelated subjects joined mainly by the phrase 'ended up,' so it is not a coherent single issue.
Some undetermined excerpts describe potentially negative situations, but their assigned sentiment must be kept separate from negative reviews.
